Even the\"}","{\"text\": \"plantlife showed a remarkable resilience. There was life yet in the blasted remains of the comberry and roobrush shrubs that once lined the main avenue. She could feel the pulse. Come springtide, green would bolt through the black. The Duke's heir, a lad\"}","{\"text\": \"of considerable intelligence and sturdy Dunmer courage, was coming down from the north to take his father's place.
